title: About Digital District
body:
A modern digital services store built for people who want quality without the hassle.

Digital District started with a simple idea: getting the tools you use every day — streaming, music, AI assistants, design software, VPNs and games — should be fast, fair and transparent. No confusing bundles, no hidden charges, no waiting days for an answer.

We curate every product we sell, price it clearly, and stand behind it for the full duration of your plan. If something stops working, we fix it or replace it. If you're not sure what to buy, we'll tell you honestly what fits your needs.

Order on the website or where you already are: WhatsApp. Add what you want to your cart, check out or send it over in one tap, and our team confirms availability, payment and activation in minutes.

## What we stand for

- **Speed** — minutes, not days: most orders are delivered the same hour.
- **Quality** — genuine access with a warranty for the full plan duration.
- **Honesty** — clear prices and straight answers, before and after you buy.
- **Reach** — serving customers across Lebanon and the region.

title: Terms & conditions
body:
This version applies to all orders placed through digitaldistrict.store.

## 1. About these terms
By placing an order with Digital District you agree to these terms. They cover how we sell digital subscriptions, licences and services, and what you can expect from us.

## 2. Orders and confirmation
Adding items to your cart does not reserve them. An order is confirmed only after our team confirms availability and payment. We may decline or cancel an order if a product becomes unavailable or if we suspect fraud.

## 3. Pricing
Prices are shown per plan and may change without notice. The price confirmed at the moment of purchase is the price that applies to your order. Products marked as on request are quoted individually.

## 4. Delivery
Digital products are delivered through WhatsApp, email or your private order page after payment is confirmed. Delivery is usually within minutes, and always within the timeframe communicated by our team.

## 5. Acceptable use
You agree to use every product in line with the provider's own terms of service, and not to resell, share beyond your plan, or otherwise abuse the access we provide. Misuse voids the warranty.

## 6. Warranty
Each plan is covered for its full duration. If a service stops working through no fault of your own, contact us and we will repair or replace it.

## 7. Liability
Digital District is not responsible for changes made by third-party providers to their own platforms, pricing or availability. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the affected order.

## 8. Contact
Questions about these terms? Message us on WhatsApp at +961 81 745 567 and we will respond quickly.

title: Privacy policy
body:
We collect the minimum information needed to deliver your order.

## Information we collect
When you place an order we collect your name, phone or WhatsApp number, optional email address, your city and delivery address when a physical delivery is needed, and the details of the products you ordered. If you create an account we also store your email address and a securely hashed password. We do not collect or store payment card data on this website — card payments, when offered, are entered on the bank's own secure page.

## How we use it
Your information is used only to process, deliver and support your order, and to contact you about it. If you subscribe to our newsletter we use your email address to send you offers, and you can unsubscribe at any time with the link in every email. We may use aggregate, non-identifying data to improve the store.

## Sharing
We never sell your data. Information is shared only with the service providers strictly needed to run the store (for example our hosting, email and payment providers, and couriers for physical deliveries) and only as required to deliver your order.

## Storage and security
Order data is stored in a secured database with restricted access. Only authorised Digital District staff can view customer orders, and sensitive delivery details such as licence keys are encrypted.

## Cookies
We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your cart between visits. No advertising trackers are used.

## Your rights
You can request a copy of your data or ask us to delete it at any time from your account's privacy page, or by messaging us on WhatsApp at +961 81 745 567. Some order records may need to be kept for accounting purposes; in that case we remove your personal details from them.

title: Refund & warranty policy
body:
Digital products are non-returnable, but every plan is covered by a working warranty.

## Warranty coverage
Every plan we sell is covered for its full paid duration. If a subscription stops working through no fault of your own, message us and we will repair or replace it at no extra cost.

## When refunds apply
A full refund is issued if we cannot deliver your order, or if we cannot repair or replace a faulty product within a reasonable timeframe. Refunds are processed through the same method used for payment.

## When refunds do not apply
Because products are digital and delivered instantly, we cannot refund an order simply because you changed your mind, ordered the wrong plan by mistake and it is already delivered, or breached the provider's terms of service.

## How to request support
Message us on WhatsApp at +961 81 745 567 with your order number and a short description of the problem, or open a support request from your account. Most issues are resolved the same day.

title: Delivery information
body:
## Digital products
Access details, licence keys, download links and activation instructions are delivered after your payment is confirmed — on WhatsApp, by email, and on your private order page. Most orders are delivered within minutes to a few hours; some services can take longer and we will always tell you in advance.

## Physical products
When physical products are available, the delivery areas, delivery fees and estimated delivery times are shown at checkout before you place your order. You can follow the status of your delivery, including the courier's tracking number when available, on your order page.
